Class OpenFrame<V>

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.testing.OpenFrame<V>
Type Parameters:
V - the frame view class
public final class OpenFrame<V> extends Object
A frame the application opened, as the tester sees it: the main frame of a single-frame application, or a frame that Frames opened. Its methods run on the EDT and settle, as the tester's do.
